text:
WOW! LOOK AT THAT MAN SWEEPING THE YARD!! 🧹✨ He’s got a BIG, BIG broom made of sticks and he’s sweeping SO HARD his arm is all the way UP in the sky!! Like he’s trying to high-five the clouds!! ☁️🙌

And look at those people walking behind him!!! One lady is wearing a HUGE white robe like she’s a GHOST but a NICE ghost!!! 👻 And another person has a RED thing on their back—maybe it’s a backpack or maybe it’s a DRAGON?? 🐉 Whoa!!

There’s even a little wooden box with a handle—like a toy chest for giants!!! And a big bag full of… STUFF?! Maybe treasure? Or leaves? I dunno but it looks IMPORTANT. 💼🍂

The building behind them is sooo long and green-roofed—it looks like a castle from a fairy tale!! But instead of knights, there are monks and sweepers!! So cool!!!

I wanna go there and help sweep!! And wear the white robe!! And ride the dragon-backpack guy!! WOOO-HOOO!!! 🎉👣
